use_case_name: Add Files to an Existing Archive

claims.content: To add one or more files to an existing archive.

goal.raw_text: To add one or more files to an existing archive.

claims.content: By selecting one or more objects to be added to an archive from file manager interface, clicking the right button of the mouse of the computer system (or the equivalent button of the equivalent input device that the computer system may have) and then selecting 'Add' from the submenu.

trigger.raw_text: By selecting one or more objects to be added to an archive from file manager interface, clicking the right button of the mouse of the computer system (or the equivalent button of the equivalent input device that the computer system may have) and then selecting 'Add' from the submenu.

claims.content: The user selects one or more files to be added to an existing archive.
The user clicks the right button of the mouse (or equivalent input device) to open the context menu.
The user selects 'Add' from the submenu.
The system opens the Create archive window.
The user defines the name and storage space for the created archives.
In cases of updating (adding objects), the name of the compressed file which is updated and its storage space remain the same as they were before the update.
The user chooses objects that are to be included in an archive.
The user sets a password and optionally a keyfile if encryption is desired.
The system compresses the selected files into the specified archive format.

If the user attempts to update (add files to) an archive in a read-only supported format (e.g., ZIP, TAR, GZ), the system prevents the operation as compression to read-only formats is not possible for updates.

If the archive being updated is encrypted ('locked') and the user does not provide the correct password and/or keyfile when prompted, the system denies access to the archive contents, preventing the addition of new files.
In case of wrong data insertion or settings during the archiving process, the application provides appropriate help messages to the user.
